nom: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Pure Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum

avis.titre: Not for the sensitive skin girlies!
avis.texte: Please don't get this!!! I broke out & am having an allergic reaction. My skin is burning, and I can't stop itching under my eyes.And, don't even get me started on the smell…

I originally saw this online and wanted to order it, but I neglected to bite the bullet. I saw it in-store and purchased. I have been using it for a few weeks now, and I can certainly tell a difference in my skin's softness and hydration. I will warn you, though, that this has a strong scent. So if you're put off by things like that, I would look for another alternative.
This serum is both affordable and completely therapeutic. Leaves skin supple and hydrated-feels more luxurious than items much more expensive. Was recommended by my dermatologist!

I look for skincare with simple ingredients that wont react to trentinoin. I use this brand for that reason. I also have used the ordinary which is decent. This hyalornic serum is comparable but better in my opinon. This serum gives my skin a glow. I have used it for a year without any break outs. I stopped having breakouts when I switched to this brand for skincare. I use this product with vanicream before putting my red light mask on. I love it because my skin glows, is smooth, and most importantly it is hydrated. I apply day and night.

don't do it. I got a free sample. my face is burning. it gave me 17 pimples in 2 days. im hoping tomorrow is better. it is so bad I had to buy allergy medicine just to calm down the rash and burn. this product is truly awful. I can't believe the ingredients they put in this.

avis.titre: Would be a great product but scent is AWFUL!
avis.texte: The Product is good. It does everything it says it's gonna do. I really enjoy the benefits, but the smell is so bad I HATE putting it on. It smells like the perfume an extremely elder lady would wear.

Hands down the best serum I've ever tried. I started using it a few months ago after a dermatitis outbreak, and I've been hooked ever since. Checks all of the boxes for me: long-lasting hydration, v glowy, clean (but subtle) scent, and makes my skin feel so soft and refreshed. Highly recommend.
Awesome serum for my morning routine. Smoothes and hydrates like no other. The scent is beautiful and feminine too. Will always have this product in my routine

avis.titre: BEST PRODUCT I HAVE EVER USED ON MY SENSITIVE SKIN 🩵
avis.texte: I have been using this product every 👏🏻 single 👏🏻 night 👏🏻 since it came on the market (over 6 years). I have not missed ONE night of applying this to my face. I can't go without it, PERIOT. 🙌🏻 No matter where I am at night - vacay, friends - this bottle goes with me. 🩵 I always thought that fragrance would break me out. Not this. I actually LOVE the scent of this. I am an ex-smoker and an ex-drinker. This product has SAVED my skin along with LRP hydrating cleanser and other products from LRP. My forehead lines and frown lines have decreased tremendously and my face is GLOWING. My face is plump and healthy looking and I can't recommend this product enough. 👏🏻💯🩵

avis.titre: Loved the original...the new one, hmm?
avis.texte: I LOVED the original formula, but suddenly they changed it and it would have been nice to know I'd be sent the updated formula (change the title Ulta! it has a new name now!), because I have concerns about using the new one! Firstly, the product now has an almost perfume-like scent. Second, it now comes with a warning on the bottle that reads: 'Caution: Flammable until dry. Keep away from flames and heat. Avoid eye area'. Why is this on a face product?! Especially one that use to work so well around the eye area. I'm so disappointed they made this change. Maybe the formula does "work" better, but is it actually better for us given the warning? I have so many questions for La Roche Posay...
This is my must-have for my skin care routine. I apply it underneath my retinol or alone when I need some hydration. I always recommend it to anyone suffering with dry skin.
It feels and smells so good. Some reviews complained about the smell but I love it. It's my favorite of all the 4 I have.

avis.titre: Finally a serum that helps my rosacea
avis.texte: I've been using this religiously day and night and my skin is finally calm and fresh looking.

This is very heavily perfumed, so not for sensitive skin. It would probably be a good product otherwise. I've used it a couple of times and it does plump, but the fragrance is so bad it burns my eyes if I get anywhere even close, so I suspect it's a marketing strategy so that you buy their fragrance free eye formula in addition to this. Likely going to return.

avis.titre: so far so good with moisture!
avis.texte: no complaints so far! Been using for a week for added moisture and the dry patch is gone!

Moroccanoil Treatment Mist is my go-to for silky, hydrated hair. It smells amazing, feels lightweight, and instantly adds smoothness and shine without weighing my hair down. Leaves hair soft and refreshed. Gifted by moroccanoil

avis.titre: A serum with actual lasting effects
avis.texte: In the dry cold winter, I search for serums and lotions that will help my dry, ezcema prone skin. Ive used Peach Lily, First Aid, Byoma. They all work fine, but none actually keep my skin moisturized. This product leaves my face so soft and moisturized that I've only felt the need to use it once a day or every other day. Some people complain about the scent. It is a bit strong, but I don't mind the smell. It goes away after 10 minutes or so. My only complaint so far after 2 weeks is the applicator needs redesigned. It dribbles and gets a bit messy.

avis.titre: Amazing best skincare product I own
avis.texte: I live in AZ plus I naturally have dry skin and redness in my face. I have aqua bomb and moisture surge which are both great but this B5 serum is by far the best! It is worth every penny.
I love this product! It smells really good and feels great gliding on the skin.

I used this due to sudden PD that i have had for over a year. I saw a lot of good reveiews so i purhcased as i already have lots of products from this brand. After 2 days of using my face is stinging, red, and so irritated. There is a very strong fragrance in this bottle, which is likely why my face is so red. If you are sensitive to that, beware. Really sad, really wanted to like this especially for the price

Other products i have purchased from this brand were fragrance free so i thought this product would be the same but i was so wrong! The scent is very overpowering. Claims to be safe for sensitive skin but the added fragrance seems to be irritating my skin!
Awful strong fragrance on this product & caused me to have an acne breakout when ive never had one in ages. All i wanted was to hydrate dry skin

Ive been looking into a serum to hydrate my skin, im realtively acne prone when trying new products so i was a little hesitant. Ive tried the ordinary hyaluronic serum and it broke me out. I use la rosche for my facewash and moisturizer so i went with this and its honesly perfect. I only wish it wasnt scented, its a pretty strong almost floral scent.

I should have read the reviews first. normally I do. the scent is over powering and all the high end products I use do not have scent. Its not necessary if the product is high quality. I might return.

These LRP products claim they are safe for sensitive and rosacea skin but they are not. I had gotten it under control and my skin looked great and the first time used this product I had a massive flare up and break out that I then had to fight for a week after. Completelt waste of money.

Ive been using a lower potency hyaluronic and figured i'd crank it up a notch with this and i can definitely tell a diffence. My skin is more plump and softer and i can definitely tell a difference when i dont use. A little goes a long way for the oily girlies like myself.

I was shocked at the powerful fragrance of this serum. It almost made me nauseous every time I used it. It also made meworry that I was putting unnecessary chemicals on my face. I eventually threw it away and replaced it with the inkey list product (which was half the price!)
Gentle on the skin. Easy to apply. It is a little sticky while it's drying. It does leave an oily finish. It is lightweight and soft on the skin.

I was about to try this until I saw there is fragrance! I only buy products for my face that's fragrance free because I'm super sensitive and can get redness, rashes & stinging with a lot of products.

As someone with combination skin & eczema, it's been challenging trying to find the right balance of products under makeup. This serum is so good because it also replaces the moisturizer so no more makeup pilling and my skin looks & feels more plump and hydrated. Absorbs quickly and has a slight sticky finish that when worn on bare face days goes away after a few minutes giving a glass skin effect but when applying makeup it gives a grippy primer effect so i've cut down the amount of products i need with just this one.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed getting to try this becauseni didnt realize how badly my under-eye area needed the TLC. I'm new to proactive skincare and this has helped tremendously! I'll be purchasing the next bottle myself its that good!
This product is wonderful, in just two weeks I have seen amazing changes.

avis.titre: Not suitable for rosacea prone skin
avis.texte: First time trying it and the next morning I had a red, angry rash of rosacea acne across both cheeks and the sides of my face. My skin was finally in a good, calm state from good products I had been using and now I have to deal with a flare again.

I started seeing results from the first use. My Dermatologist recommended this product along with the Vitamin C12 and it has done wonders for me. I have very sensitive skin so I was shocked to find that it didn't cause any irritation for me. I'm going to continue to use it until it's finished and hope to add as part of my skincare regimen.

avis.titre: Love the results—on my second bottle!
avis.texte: I love this serum and will keep coming back for more. The scent is strong at first, but I actually like it now. My skin feels smoother and more hydrated with consistent use. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine.

The outside packaging was intact, although it came in a soft bubble pack. However, the box of this product itself looked like its been squished, the box end was completely ripped off AND included inside the packaging. It makes me doubt the integrity of the product itself. Going to return. Disappointed that I bought it online instead of going into store. The whole point is for convenience. Ulta is a credible store. But this type of occurrence says a lot.

I have been using this serum every single day since it came out. (Background: VERY sensitive skin, prone to breakouts, oily aging skin). I have never had a reaction to the fragrance in this (which I find a very pleasant smell) and my skin has improved DRASTICALLY after using this in my skincare routine every night. The market is over-saturated with hyaluronic acids but this one is built different. This is a very thick, tacky serum that really plumps the skin. (I believe this is due to a higher volume of pure hyalu in it). I have tried others out there but this one is the real winner in my opinion. 🩵

avis.titre: Fragrance is a no for me
avis.texte: This is a great serum minus the fragrance. The fragrance triggered my allergy to certain fragrances (proven through skin testing at my derm) and gave me red skin and a rash on my eyelids. Burned when I applied it after the first few times. Too bad, because it does feel very smooth and the few times I did use it my skin felt so soft. Returned.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I don't like how sticky it is after applying, it feels weird to blink a little bit lol. However, I do appreciate how long it stays on the skin and the benefits!
I've only been using it for a week, so far I like it. It's smooth and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and moisturized.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This comes in a very cute little package, and the applicator with the cooling roller feels really good. It seems hydrating but will need to use it a little longer for sure.

I've been using the hylua b5 eye serum over a month now and I can definitely see an improvement in my under circles. My under eyes look less dark they feel less dry and crapey . I like that it has a cooling tip applicator that depuffs . I use this in the mornings and my eye puffiness instantly goes away. I would repurchase again but this eye serum is actually improving my overall eye circles I see a them lightening slowly but surely there's been an overall improvement
I absolutely love this serum! It has made my skin feel so smooth and it smells lovely.

I love everything about this serum except for the fragrance. It's simply too much. It's not that it smells BAD, it's just very strong & it lasts for hours. And i work in the OR, so i wear a mask the majority of the day and the scent just gets trapped in my mask. So for this reason, i won't be repurchasing.
I tried this after seeing positive reviews but it didn't work for me. I have sensitive skin and this stung a little bit while being applied and made my skin breakout 🥲

⸻ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely love LaRiche Pusay Hylau B5! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly hydrated and smooth without any greasiness. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly and gives my complexion a healthy, refreshed glow. Perfect for daily use—definitely a staple in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: PERFECT FOR MY SKIN, SO HYDRATING
avis.texte: Loved it, bought a bottle couple months ago and that went well. Will be repurchasing.
I use this everyday 3 times morning and night along with three vitamins c and dark spots remover all great!!

I was hopeful that I would like this product. I did like the way it felt on my skin but ended up returning it fairly quick. Fragrance is way too overpowering. I could smell it on my skin all day. Interfered with other fragrances. Had to return product.

avis.titre: Wish it was made in fragrance-less formula
avis.texte: A lot of LRP are fragrence free. But not this one for some reason
I have sensituve skin and rosacea. Ive tried many brands and thid is one of my favorites!
I saw instant results after the first use. Skimmer was visibly plumper and hydrated. Will continue to use this product.
This product is great but why does it have a floral fragrance? There is no need to make everything STINK. I want to buy again but not until they make a fragrance free version
The LaRoche- posay hyalu b5 is an incredible serum. Really softens lines & wrinkles and goes on so smoothly. This is my 2nd bottle!! Will continue to buy!!

I absolutely love this stuff. The dropper does not fill to the top, however it put's just the right amount in it. You only need a small amount to spread over yiur wntire face and neck! This makes a huge difference in my fine lines and jeeps my skin hydrated all day. I have stopoed using fir a short bit and definitely can tell a difference when i do. I highly recommend!!
I love this serum so much. I have repurchased this several times. Its very hydrating on my skin. Leaves my skin glowing. And i love how plumped my skin feels too. I recommend for sure!!!
I wish I had the same results that orners had. I didn't notice any difference at all.

I used this product and noticed it had a strong fragrance smell but still wanted to give it a try and then next day i had alot of whiteheads near my chin , they went away but now that area is super dry and really burns

avis.titre: I can't go without my La Roche-Posay HYALU B5 Serum!
avis.texte: I just can't be without it. I first purchased my first bottle about 2 years ago. After I ran out I tried a less expensive hyaluronic bottle. No comparison, not even close. I returned right back to La Roche-Posay and am very pleased with the results, and quality.

avis.titre: Glad I added this to my routine
avis.texte: I added this to my daily skincare routine about 3 months ago. It has definitely improved the overall appearance of my skin. This is a before picture from November and the second one is the beginning of February.
This hyaluronic acid is a staple in my routine. I use it just about everyday. It helps keep my skin moisturized.

avis.titre: Drugstore that does better than prestige
avis.texte: I am a dry girly and this serum is 10/10 for maintaining a dewy glow. I use both mornkng and night. Paired with citaplast baum also from LRP, best winter skin combo ive ever tried!
Have repurchased this product about 4 or 5 times now and i love it. I have very dry skin and this does the job

My skin feels smooth and supple. I have used other serums and this seems to deliver about the same results. It's more affordable than at least one of the others I was using and I feel it's just as good. There is a very, very light scent that disappears within seconds of application. You only need a little bit of this am and pm - it goes a long way.
Used twice and the strong perfume fragrance gave me a headache. I don't know why fragrance needed to be added to this product. Serum seemed to work well otherwise.

I really like it. I have sensitive oily acne-prone skin. It doesn't leave a slimy or sticky residue on the skin and has no fragrance. I haven't had any breakouts caused by it. I recommend using it at night, preferably right after washing your face, it absorbs way better.

I like how hydrating this hyaluronic acid serum is! I use this in the morning after cleansing. Knocking it down a star because of the added fragrance - it's a bit too strong for my liking! Other than that, I like this product and would recommend it.

I have purchased multiple bottles of this and I use this product daily and love it so much! Unfortunately, the 2 most recent bottles I have tried smell like sulfur. I put two drops on my face in the morning and my face smells like sulfur all day. Even tastes like it. I exchanged the most recent bottle I bought thinking it was defective. But the other one smells like it as well. Please bring back the pretty fragrance it had before!! I'm so sad. I am going to have to find a new huyaluronic acid serum to use. Please help!!! This used to be my favorite.

A friend of mine recommended this to me along with the La Roche-Posay Lipikar Wash AP+ Gentle Foaming Moisturizing Wash. This combination is a force to be reckoned with. My skin is almost always clear these days (minus hormonal acne, that's a beast of its own). This doesn't irritate my rosacea and helps keep my skin hydrated. I have tried with a few different face moisturizers and haven't had any reaction to multiple different combinations.

This is a good product overall. I personally think it feels a little sticky when applied but it blends in nicely with other products. Initially it did cause minimal breakouts, but i decided to trust the process and my skin did become accustomed to the product and no more breakouts. I finished the whole bottle and im overall happy i got it. It is hydrating and I can definitely see my self buying it again. For an alternative naturium is good brand . I love the vitamin c serum its very good as well and wont break the bank.
I've had this product recommended to me twice but the second i put it on my face i could smell the strong frangrance. So perfumey. Why would they ruin this product with fragrance??? Gross. Returning.

I feel as though even if this was THE BEST HA I wouldn't buy it again. First use and the stopper slipped out of my hands and shattered. Now I have it uncovered with a tiny VICHY stopper I received in a sampler kit. Won't buy again.
Disappointed, Roche-Posay is normally great for my sensitive skin. However, this formula burns my skin, it has way too much fragrance.

I would buy it again. It seems to help with redness and small bumps on my cheeks due to mild rosacea. It helps with dryness and my skin felt smooth and moisturized but not oily. It layered well under my moisturizer and did not pill. I havent used it long enough to be able to say its helping with fine lines, but my skin does seem to appear "brighter" (im fair/light in makeup) and moisturized. I took off 1 star because it has added fragramce. Why do companies still add fragrance to skincare? It's unnecessary abd just another thing that can irritate skin.

LRP… please NEVER change this formula! im so obsessed with this hyal serum. its extremely moisturizing (for someone with very dry skin) and smells amazing. wish it was a little less exensive but its so worth it, ive probably bought 100 bottles at this point. highly recommend!

I have never had a product's fragrance bother me. This smells so bad and my face turns red and burns with it. It also doesn't absorb all the way in and leaves a layer on my skin so I can't wear it under my makeup. It is moisturizing so 2 stars but I will not repurchase.

I last ordered this in January and just ran out this month and wilk be ordering again! Despite its price tag, this is a product where a little goes a long way. I have noticed it help with scarring and uneven skin tone, and an overall healthy skin feeling. A staple in my skin care routine.
I think this is my first serum and I love it. Didn't find it sticky or there is no fragrance!!
I love this stuff. I put it on fresh out of the shower when my skin is still damp, followed by lotion, my skin has never felt so good!

I have been using this every night now for 6 months. My overly-sensitive face loves this serum. 🩵 I have forehead lines and laugh lines that are looking less prominent and I love the moisture that this serum provides. Yes, this is a very sticky, tacky serum but that is due to the pureness of the hyaluronic content. A lot of other serums use fillers and add other ingredients. This one has given my face new life (without any adverse side effects) and I will continue to use this every night as part of my skin care routine. 🩵
I lovee it at first but, After using for a few days, i started to get painful cycstic acne :(

I have repurchased this product so many times and I am so obsessed!! I dont typically spend a lot of money on beauty/makeup/skincare, but I preach on this product and I have repurchased multiple times!! It makes my skin feel SO hydrated and makes it look so healthy and plump. Acne safe as well!

avis.titre: It is  the best serum I tried. Highly recommended
avis.texte: It's a must in my daily skin routine. I can't start my day with it. I use after thermal spring water.
I've tried many products for the skin of my forehead which has been so dry. After trying this products for a month, the dryness was gone. Ever since, I've been using this product.

I have purchased this product multiple times and have been happy with it. I have found it easy to add to my skin care routine and havent felt it had caused any skin issues for my acne prone, combo skin. I generally mix it with a moisturizer and use it once or twice a day during my AM/PM routine.
I really saw the difference in the first week! I love the texture and the smell!

It works fine. The frangrance is way too strong. I don't mind some frangrance, but do not like florals. It does go away quickly, but I dread putting it on my face. The dropper isnt great and the bottle is too slippery when you're hand have product on them.

I am very picky about what goes on my face, I do not enjoy the thick sticky feeling but it does subside quickly. I do love that I've only used it continuously for about 3 weeks and I can see a huge difference in my skin! My skin is brighter and my fine lines have lessened for sure. I've gotten many compliments on my skin and asked what I use. It's worth the sticky feeling! I will continue using this long term.
I'm so happy with this product. I always have it on hand. This product with a good vitamin c serum and I'm good to go in the summer. I don't even need a foundation.
All day results. My skin feels amazing. I have dry spots and this moisturizer has help. Goes on silky smooth.
Had a really bad reaction to this serum. My got so read and itchy. Looked like a chemical burn.

I've had acne since I was about 12 years old. It took me until 6 months ago to find out that hyaluronic acid completely clears my skin, and I'm 26. I tried the cerave HA serum, and though it cleared my skin, it also caused burning. When I ran out, I started breaking out all over again. I decided to try pure HA this time, and this immediately cleared my skin. No burning at all, as expected. I have no choice but to continue buying this because it works so well!
One of the best products I have used. It improves the appearance of your skin from day one.
I wanted to love this regimen. Unfortunately it irritated my skin and caused extreme breakouts. It smells wonderful. The formula just wasn't right for my skin type.

Very Sticky and heavily fragranced. I prefer almost every other Hyaluronic acid serum i've tried. I will not repurchase. Other lotions are and products from this brand are much better than this. It's a pass for me.
This is an amazing product. It glides on easily and completely melts into the skin, allowing other products to be layered easily.
My face is glowing! Some scars are lightening and fine lines no longer visible. Skin feels supple and smooth.
The fragrance is atrocious, smells like strong rose perfume but not in a good way. The serum itself absorbed quickly but I has to immediately wash it off.
I don't really know what it does but it has made my skin look much more glowy and very soft.
Love this serum. I can see visible results after one month of use!

I normally buy only fragrance-free products, but decided to try this Hyalu serum. The scent was very light in the bottle, but when applied to my face, the fragrance was too strong for me and did not dissipate even after a couple of hours....very unpleasant and gave me a headache. I took the bottle back to the place of purchase and got a refund (minus the amount of the store discount coupons I had used).
My skin is happy! First thing my daughter said after not seeing me for a bit was"Mom your skin looks great"
Love this product! I can see a significant difference in my skin in just a week.

avis.titre: First day using and smell is off putting
avis.texte: First day using this so i cant speak for how it works and dont know if ill be able to as the smell is so bad I dont see how i can continue to use it. Im sensitive to scent & get headaches easily so this was a disappointment for sure.
Can't use it due to very strong perfume smell - tried twice but simply cannot tolerate
